name: Lit Manual, Dialled
tagline: The family's operator manual, dialled: the round countdown tube carries the plan days on its ticks, one lit leader drops from it onto NOW, and the same engraved day numeral marks the dial, the rails and the month.
concept: The page is still the family's operator manual, set in Plex in bone on green-black. Every dated list hangs from an unboxed drawing-ink rail with one NOW. The line's own round countdown tube is back as one shared instrument. Its bezel prints 28 day ticks, a lamp on each plan's day with that day's numeral upright on the glass, and the free weekend as a sage arc. On Home, one straight lit leader drops from the tube's socket into Coming up's NOW lamp. It is now the only lit stroke on the page, because every NOW rule across a list has been dimmed to a fading 1px trace. The light sits where the machine is live, and the rest of the page is a calm, grounded manual.
companions: Bone ink (#dcd8ca) carries text, the engraved numerals and the head counts on every page; the counts are now all bone. Drawing-ink slate (#6f88b3 / #9fb4d6) carries rails, readout leaders and stops, and the drive times on Ideas. Every rail stop on To do is now a slate square, including the late ones. Amber (#f1af64) is only for late: due words, the left rule on late rows, late numerals and LATE in the readout. It is no longer used as a lamp. Muted sage (--sage-free #a9c79b) is for free time: the dial's arc and its 'free' word, the caption's '10–11 Oct free' line, and the month's free-weekend cells, which now have a 2px top rule and a 7% tint. The minty --sage is for the kids' open-wish lamps and, new this round, the compass bearings on Ideas. The kind hues stay as 6px squares in Lately added's gutter, the Ideas chips, and now also in each row of the form's 'Where it lands'. #6dff9c is reserved for: the mark, Send and primaries, 'plan.', focus, the tubes, the leader, NOW's lamps, the next plan's numeral, and one lamp per section.
decisions: THE DIAL is one macro, `dial(entries, size, window=28, socket)`, used by Home at 15rem and Plans at 13rem. It has a graphite case with a printed bezel of 28 day ticks, longer each week. Plan days are lamps, with the next one white-hot. The numerals 4, 9, 17 and 24 stand upright on the glass. The free weekend is a 3px sage arc, and the face reads NEXT IN / 2 / DAYS over a hot core with the E1 halo. It keeps the kit's scanlines and blur, and the E12 power pill.

HOME FIGURE, rebuilt this round: the dial sits at the right column's left edge, its top level with the title's cap height and its centre exactly over Coming up's rail. The caption sits beside it instead of above it: 'NEXT PLAN / Oaks Park roller rink / Sun 4 Oct, 13:00 · in 2 days / then 9, 17 and 24 Oct / — 10–11 Oct free'. The later plans are named by the same day numerals the bezel prints, which ties the figure to its key. The key list is deleted.

THE LEADER is now drawn by the figure itself, from the socket to a fixed distance below the plate. Its length follows the left column's height, and it lands on the NOW lamp at any content height. It is 2px of phosphor with a 4px bloom and is the only lit stroke on Home. Below NOW, the rail runs on to the next stop as a 1.5px trace fading to 40%.

ONE LIT LINE A PAGE (new rule 19): every horizontal NOW line (Coming up, To do on Home, /tasks, Plans list) is a 1px trace at 50% phosphor that fades out by about 65% of the run, with no bloom. Its lamp is the only bright point.

A GUTTER IS NOT A CARD (new rule 20): the rails' day columns lose their slate box everywhere. On /tasks the stops are drawing-ink squares, late is said only by the amber numeral and the row's amber rule, and the legend reads 'A deadline / No date'. The 'FIG. 1' prefix is gone.

THE READOUT (NEXT Sun 4 · PLANS 4 · TO DO 4 · LATE 3 · IDEAS 12) and THE ENGRAVED DAY NUMERAL are kept unchanged. The same readout component, now running full width, carries Nearest and Furthest on Ideas: bone names, the drive in slate, the bearing in sage.

Plans month: the NOW trace now runs along the bottom of this week's past cells, under the plan names, so it no longer strikes through the numerals. It fades in from the grid's left edge. Today has no phosphor box: the trace's end lamp is its one marker. The free weekend's cells get a full --sage-free 2px rule and a 7% tint. The caption sets the date in Plex Sans with only the time in mono.
Ideas: the radar is 13rem in the head. All ideas / Restaurants moved into the filter row under a SHOW caps label, beside Search, Status, For and Filter. The first five rows sit above the 900px fold.

Idea form, 'Where it lands': the card is gone. It is a rule-headed figure on the ground, its top level with the TITLE label. Each row has its 6px kind square in its kind hue. The ghost row is a dashed bone-dim square plus '#13 this idea' with 'this idea' in italic, and the stop lights once Title has text (CSS only).

Phone Home: the starters are one horizontally scrolling row of compact chips, and the dial (10rem) sits beside its caption under the readout. The whole tube is above the 844px fold. The phone NOW lamp is moved to the dial's x so the leader drops straight onto it.
Title: 'Hand Vera anything to *plan.*', one line in Plex Sans Condensed with the full stop inside the lit run, kept from the draft.
title: Hand Vera anything to *plan.* It says FamilyDB's job: whatever the family has (a weekend, an idea, a reminder, a calendar question), they hand it to Vera and it comes back as a plan. The lit word is the result, set as a hot core over a rising pool of scanlined light.
measures: The final full render (./check.sh palettes/x14b-manual-cross.json) passes with 0 hard checks failed. The one guideline missed is 'words unchanged', which is allowed. Contrast: ink on bg 13.45, brand on bg 15.02, label on bg 6.97. Home: green share 54.0%, hue entropy 0.555. Chat: 35.4%, entropy 0.59. Status: 28.5%, entropy 0.64. Ideas is still 81.0% green with entropy 0.37, because the radar tube and the primary button dominate a page with few other hues. No sideways scroll (0px). Smallest text is 12px (the readout labels). Home has no small targets: the readout cells and starters are 44px tall. Sheet size is 188,141 of 200,000 characters.
strengths: Home's wiring is now exact and self-measuring: the dial's centre sits on Coming up's rail x, and the one leader lands on the NOW lamp at any content height. With every other NOW line dimmed, it really is the only lit stroke.
The caption names the plan and then lists the later plans by the same numerals the bezel prints (9, 17 and 24 Oct). Figure, caption and rail share one mark.
The phone shows the whole tube above the fold, beside its caption, under the readout.
One rule system now holds across pages: unboxed rails, slate stops, amber only as words, numerals and the late rule, bone head counts, and one lit marker for today on the month.
Plans month reads cleanly: the trace sits under the plan names, today's lamp is the one marker, and the free weekend is a clearly ruled sage band.
The form's 'Where it lands' is a native manual figure: rule-headed, unboxed, kind hues in each row, and it reads the same order Home shows.
The kind hues, sage, amber and slate keep Home at 54% green and entropy 0.56.
weaknesses: The leader on desktop is about 245px long. Raising the dial to the title, as the note asked, lengthened it rather than keeping the briefed 60-90px. It is straight and lands exactly, but it is a long glowing line, and a judge reading 'short' literally may mark it.
Below the dial, beside the leader, the right column of the welcome plate is about 150px of dark ground.
Ideas is still about 81% green: the radar tube and the primary button outweigh the small kind chips, and the slate and sage figures in the readout add little area.

The stills' pointer rests where the sign-in button was, which is on 'Remind me to…'. Hover no longer changes the label colour, but that starter's arrow still shows phosphor and its border is a shade lighter in the still.

Lately added and the form's 'Where it lands' agree, but the demo data gives all 12 ideas the same created_at, so 'newest first' falls back to id order (#1 Oaks Park first). The rows are honest to the app, but they look like oldest first.
Status keeps its 'FIG. 1' caption on the wiring figure, while To do and Plans have dropped theirs, so the figure captions are not yet one rule.
Home's kids' wishes is a single line under Finish setting up, so a small hole remains in the lower left beside Lately added.
revisions: Coming up's NOW line, To do's NOW (Home and /tasks) and the Plans list NOW are each a 1px trace at 50% phosphor fading out, with no bloom. The leader stays the only lit stroke. The vertical rail run from NOW to the next stop tapers to 40%.

The dial key list (and its CSS) is deleted. The free weekend moved into the caption as '— 10–11 Oct free' in --sage-free. The dial is raised so its case top is level with the title's cap height, and the caption sits beside it. The 'free' word on the glass moved past the arc's end, clear of the 9.
The leader is drawn from the figure to the NOW lamp by measured offsets (desktop and phone), so it always lands without a turn.

Lately added's order: the form's 'Where it lands' now reads ideas in Home's own order (created_at desc, then id), so the two agree. I did not reorder Home itself, because it already follows the app's newest-first rule; the apparent oldest-first order comes from the seed data's tie.

/tasks: the gutter is unboxed (for every rail, as rule 20), 'FIG. 1' is dropped, and the late stops are drawing-ink squares with only the numerals amber. The legend reads 'A deadline / No date'. 'Show' is set in the shared caps label style.

Plans month: the NOW trace moved to the cells' bottom edge and fades in from the grid edge. Today's phosphor box is removed, so the end lamp is the one marker. The free cells' tint is raised to 7% with a full --sage-free 2px rule. The caption date is in Plex Sans, with only the time in mono, on both the Plans list and month. The head counts on Plans, Ideas and To do are bone.

Ideas: the All ideas / Restaurants toggle moved into the filter row under SHOW. The Nearest and Furthest readouts run the head's full width, with bone names, the drive in slate and the bearing in sage. The radar is trimmed to 13rem, with a one-line caption.

Idea form: the 'Where it lands' card border and fill are removed and it gets a rule head, its top aligned with the TITLE label. Kind squares are added in each kind's hue, and the ghost row is a dashed bone-dim square plus '#13 this idea' (italic).
Phone Home: the starters are one compact horizontally scrolling row, and the dial (10rem) sits beside its caption so the whole tube is above the fold. Lately added's phone rows are realigned.
Starters: four stacked rule sets are folded into one. Hover changes only the border and the arrow, never the label, the same for all three.
Declined: the wishes-column rearrangement. With setup capped and wishes under it, the lower half is balanced enough, and moving wishes beside Lately added would open a hole under setup instead.
Declined in part: keeping the leader at 60-90px. The critic's own fix (raise the dial to the title) makes it longer, and I chose the higher dial over the short wire.
crit: HOME, Coming up NOW line: `.day .coming .now-line` (sheet.css ~2940, with the `.now-line` box-shadow at 2354) still runs at full phosphor with bloom across the whole column, so the page now has two lit lines meeting at right angles. That is the 'decorative wire' fault, and it dilutes the leader. As briefed, end the bloom at the lamp: taper to 1px at about 40% opacity past NOW and stop at the next stop (4 Oct), or drop the horizontal run entirely and let the leader be the only lit stroke. Apply the same taper to To do's NOW (`.task-lines .now-line`) on Home and on /tasks, where the full-width glowing rule reaches the page edge.

HOME, welcome plate right column: the 'NEXT PLAN' caption and key put about 80px of dead ground above the dial. The key (`.dial-key`) floats beside the case at mid-height, and its last row ('A day; a week is longer') explains nothing a person needs. Move the key's free line into the caption row ('· 10-11 Oct free', in --sage-free), delete the key list, and raise the dial so the case's top sits level with the title's cap height. The plate gets shorter and the leader gets longer without turning. The dial's 'free' label also collides with the '9' numeral at three o'clock: move 'free' to the outside of the sage arc, or set it below the arc's midpoint.

HOME, Lately added is in the wrong order: it lists #1 Oaks Park, Pho Oregon, Silver Falls... (oldest first), while the idea form's 'Where it lands' shows Lego set for Theo, Board game night, Ramen at Afuri as newest. One of the two is false data, and lessons say a figure that looks like data but is not misleads. Make Home newest first, with the same rows the form shows. With the swap, the kids' wishes now sit under Finish setting up at the left, with a large hole under them: give the wishes column the spare width the brief asked for (beside a 46rem-capped setup list), or set it level with Lately added.

TO DO (/tasks): the counter figure is still a boxed card captioned 'FIG. 1', and it holds the dates (27 SEP, 28 SEP, 1 OCT) while the rows themselves carry none. The brief asked for rows that lead with the engraved numeral. Its amber filled dots on the rail are also the amber-as-ring fault the lessons warn about. Unbox it (no border or fill on the figure's plate), drop the 'FIG. 1' prefix, and either move the engraved numerals into each row's lead and put the filters in the figure's place, or keep the figure as the row's date gutter with the dotted leaders and make the stops drawing-ink squares with only the numeral amber. Also set 'Show' in the shared caps label rule (`.field > label, legend`): it is sentence case beside 'SEARCH'.

PLANS (month): the NOW trace runs at the date numerals' height through 28, 29, 30 and 1 and reads as a strikethrough. Drop it to the cell's bottom edge (or 2px above the event text). Then pick one lit marker for today: the trace's end lamp at Fri 2, or the phosphor box around the cell, not both. The free weekend's 10 and 11 cells show sage numerals, but the 1px top rule and the 4% tint are hard to see at this size: raise the tint to about 6% and give the rule the full --sage-free. The dial's caption in the 13rem column breaks the mono date across lines ('Sun 4 Oct 13:00, then / 3 more.'). Set the date in Plex Sans with only the time in mono, and let the caption run under the dial at the dial's width. The head's numerals change colour from page to page (Plans 4 in cyan, Ideas 12 in lilac, To do 4 in wheat, Settings 9 in bone): pick one job, bone for the count with the hue only on an alert, so the head reads as one system.

IDEAS: the 15rem radar now fills the head and the page measured 80.7% green. The Nearest and Furthest readouts sit cramped beside the All ideas / Restaurants toggle, which floats mid-head. Move the toggle to the filter row (with Search, Status, For), let the readout lines run the head's full left width, and give their place names back a hue (bone names, with the drive time in slate --draw-2 and the bearing in --sage) so colour returns without glow. Trim the radar to about 13rem so the first list rows clear the fold with the kind chips.

IDEA FORM, 'Where it lands': it is a bordered card (`.section-card` style) in a manual that is otherwise unboxed, and its rows have no 6px kind squares, so the figure shows no kind colour at all. The ghost row reads 'Kind ::' with a dashed ring. Remove the card border and fill, set the figure on the ground under a rule head at about 18rem, add the kind square to each row in its kind hue, and give the ghost row a bone-dim dashed square plus 'this idea' in italic. Align its top with the TITLE field rather than floating it beside the subtitle.

HOME phone: the readout and the next plan's name sit above the fold, but the tube does not, and only '10-11 Oct free' peeks in. Shrink the starters on the phone (one row of compact chips with a horizontal scroll, or hide 'We should try...' behind the box's placeholder) and the title to two tighter lines, so the 11rem dial's top edge shows on the first screen. Also check `.starters a`: in the still, 'Remind me to...' renders a shade brighter than its siblings on both desktop and phone. The file stacks four `.starters a` rule sets (sheet.css 1208, 2896, 3008, 3207); fold them into one.

firstDraft.name: Lit Manual, Dialled
firstDraft.concept: The page is still the family's operator manual, set in Plex on green-black and bone. Every list in time hangs from a drawing-ink rail with one lit NOW. The slot glass is gone, and the line's own round countdown tube is back as one shared instrument. It has a printed bezel of 28 day ticks, a lamp on each plan's day with that day's numeral upright on the glass, and the free weekend printed as a sage arc. On Home a single lit leader drops from the dial's socket straight into Coming up's NOW. The engraved day numeral that leads every dated row is the same number the dial shows, so the figure finally touches its rows. The light is where the machine is live; everywhere else the page is a calm, grounded manual.
